headers.//: Everything is revalidated by default. Storybook's manager and addon bundles (sb-manager, sb-addons, sb-common-assets, vite-inject-mocker-entry.js) keep the SAME filename across builds, so a cached copy is served into a page that expects the new one — which is what produced 'Illegal invocation' and 'couldn't find story matching id' on days with several deploys.

Only /assets is safe to keep forever: those filenames carry a content hash (Accordion-dndm9R3d.css), so a change produces a new name rather than new bytes under the old one. This rule is listed last so it wins for that path.
